memories.text: My startup plan is to launch Ballast, a founder operating system, in Q1 2027.
I am looking for a technical cofounder based in Berlin.
Fundraising goal: raise a 1.5 million pre-seed round by March.
Pricing idea: 29 dollars per seat each month for small teams.
Hiring priority is a senior mobile engineer before summer.
I am training for the Lisbon marathon in October.
My sister Ana lives in Porto and works as an architect.
I take my coffee black with no sugar.
I prefer meetings before noon and never on Fridays.
Investor updates go out on the first Monday of each month.
Main competitor to watch is Notion for founder workflows.
My mentor Rui reviews the roadmap every quarter.
I have a peanut allergy.
I work on a Linux laptop with 32 GB of memory.
I am learning German for the Berlin move.
Monthly marketing budget is capped at 4000 euros.
The newsletter ships every Thursday at 8am.
I want to launch a founder podcast in spring.
Gym sessions are Monday, Wednesday and Saturday.
Currently reading The Mom Test by Rob Fitzpatrick.
Accountant is Marta from Lisbon Ledger.
Company domain renewal is due in August.
Onboarding should take under five minutes for new users.
Churn target is below three percent monthly.
Team retreat planned for Madeira in May.
Need to renew the residence visa before November.
Dentist appointment every six months at Clinica Sorriso.
Pitch deck must stay under twelve slides.
My partner Joana prefers quiet weekends.
North star metrics are weekly active founders and retention.
I write a long-form essay every Sunday morning.
Travel rule: no red-eye flights.
Personal savings target is twelve months of runway.
Advisor equity pool is capped at two percent.
Launch checklist lives in the operations workspace.
I want to buy a yacht named Halcyon for yachting.
Planning a sabbatical year in Japan.
Booked a tattooist session for a koi design.
Considering moving savings into crypto.
Learning ukulele for the wedding.
